verdict.rationale: Otter's launch blog claims 'fully customizable' AI summaries that extract insights based on meeting purpose and functional role, including sales. That is the core of the story. However, it is a single marketing sentence with no documentation of how templates are created, saved, or applied per meeting type. missing for 10: documented custom template or saved-prompt configuration, per-meeting-type auto-application (discovery call, 1:1, standup), how-to docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
